title: Book 6 DRILL: Inheritance
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 6 · 7 questions · 60 marks · about an hour · all outcomes 2(u) to 2(dd)
los_html:
The whole book in one drill, covering all outcomes 2(u) to 2(dd). Read 1a - STUDY SHEET - Book 6 ... (condensed) first.

Most of the marks in this book are in the LAYOUT of the genetic diagram, not the biology. Draw every diagram in full, seven rows, gametes circled, genotypes under phenotypes. A right answer in the wrong shape still loses.
